Title: 3 Everyday Habits That May Trigger Scalp Folliculitis

Description:
Hot tub soaks, tight ponytails, and heavy styling wax - these three everyday habits can all trigger those painful, acne-like bumps on your scalp.

Here's why each one sets it off, and small swaps that may help.

Bumps on your scalp that look like acne and hurt to touch? 🧴

Hot tub soaks, tight ponytails, and heavy styling wax are three everyday habits that can trigger scalp folliculitis.

Rinse off after hot tubs, loosen your ponytail, and keep heavy products off your scalp.
